data.description:
docker-storage-cap.sh effective_gc_verdict reads BuildKit's effective GC ceiling from `docker buildx inspect` by matching only `Keep Bytes:` lines. That function serves both the --install readback and the every-tick --check-gc-enforced probe.

docker/buildx commands/inspect.go prints `Keep Bytes:` through v0.17.0. From v0.18.0 it prints `Reserved Space:`, `Max Used Space:` and `Min Free Space:` instead, and omits any value of zero. https://github.com/docker/buildx/blob/v0.18.0/commands/inspect.go

Consequence: on a host whose buildx CLI plugin is v0.18.0 or later, the parser finds no lines. effective_gc_verdict returns 2 (unreadable), --check-gc-enforced prints nothing and exits 1, and docker_buildkit_gc_enforced reports unknown permanently. That is the same blind spot bug 007c-dabe-21a5-4e92 closed. The buildx plugin version moves independently of dockerd, so a routine package update can trigger this without any Engine change.

Not live today: rebar-gerrit's inspect output still prints `Keep Bytes:` (measured 2026-11-03 per test_check_gc_enforced_prints_0_on_the_live_host_shape).

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] effective_gc_verdict derives the effective ceiling from the new labels. The ceiling is Max Used Space when present, otherwise Reserved Space, matching BuildKit calculateKeepBytes = max(maxUsed, reserved) when min-free is zero. Legacy `Keep Bytes:` output must still parse.
- [ ] tests/scripts/test_docker_storage_cap.py covers --check-gc-enforced over a buildx >= 0.18 inspect fixture for the match, mismatch and unreadable cases.
- [ ] Output for the current production inspect shape is unchanged.

Found 2026-11-03 while root-causing antitoxic-malophilic-starling (session a85e3cd3).
data.title: docker-storage-cap GC readback misses buildx>=0.18 labels
